The '''Arrochar Royal Palace''' was a building on Arrochar that housed the local Royal House.

==Description==
The palace was a large stone structure, with many towers spread across it length, with turquoise tiled spires. The interior of the palace was extremely luxurious, with wide halls and rooms, with many stone statues placed on the corridors.
